Compute Match — Local
Development Guide
Prerequisites
Git, Bash, Make, Docker Desktop with Compose v2, and NVIDIA
network/VPN access.
Either
Devbox
0.18.3 or newer (supplies all tools)
or installed tools: Node 22 (frontend), Python 3.13 and
uv
(backend and worker).
Docker-only mode (
make onboard
,
make start
) needs no Node or Python on your laptop.
First run
make
onboard
# build containers, prepare databases and identity, create demo accounts and inventory
make
verify
# should finish with "status": "ready"
The first build can take 10–20 minutes. Without Make, run
./local-setup/onboard.sh
. If it fails, read
local-setup/.onboarding/setup.log
, fix the problem and
rerun.
Open
http://localhost:3000
, click
Login
, enter a demo account email, then its generated
password.
Demo accounts
Passwords are generated into
local-setup/.onboarding/accounts.md
(human guide) and
credentials.json
(machine-readable, includes the Keycloak
admin login). These files are Git-ignored.
Experience
Account
Customer
developer@customer-a.example.org
Provider (NCP)
seed@singtel.example.org
Platform business admin
business-admin@platform.example.org
Operations
ops@platform.example.org
Normal onboarding creates 17 accounts; Singtel and Firmus provider
accounts test isolation between NCPs, and colleague accounts test shared
inventory inside one NCP.
make onboard ONBOARD_ARGS="--with-scenarios"
adds
22-account regression personas, including
pending@scenarios.example.org
(pending activation),
terms@scenarios.example.org
(terms not accepted),
restricted@scenarios.example.org
(active, no business
role),
infra-manager@customer-a.example.org
and
tech-admin@customer-b.example.org
.
Test sign-ups with addresses such as
you@example.com
;
example.com
and
nvidia.com
auto-activate,
personal domains are blocked, and local email delivery is disabled. A
new sign-up may need a role assigned in Keycloak
(
customer
realm → user →
Role
mapping
), then sign out and in again.
make onboard ONBOARD_ARGS="--no-seed"
creates accounts
without demo inventory. Sample CSVs for upload testing are in
local-setup/fixtures/
.

Configuration files
Location
Use

Everyday loop
make stop
at the end of the day keeps your data;
make start
resumes. Use
make status
, then
make logs SERVICE=...
when something looks wrong.

Problem
Fix

Connect to the NVIDIA VPN

Use Node 22 or set
LOCAL_DEV_NODE

Restore localhost public URLs in the generated settings
Signed up but see no features
Assign a realm role in Keycloak and sign in again

make obs-start
